headline: Investigators traced a $4.86 million outflow from Chainflip’s Ethereum vault, but have not established how the withdrawal was authorized. Microsoft says it fixed a flaw that exposed Entra Connect Health tenant metadata; the FBI has not publicly confirmed the reported intrusion into its national crime database.

incidents.what: Chainflip paused the protocol after on-chain investigators identified a $4.86 million Ethereum vault outflow; how the vault authorized the transfer remains unknown.
Microsoft said a server-side flaw let an unauthorized party read administrator email addresses and tenant metadata, with no unauthorized configuration changes found.
CNN, AP and Fox News independently cited sources describing an apparent intrusion into the FBI’s national crime database; the FBI declined to comment to AP.
Germany’s Federal Employment Agency confirmed an attack on its separately run property-management systems and said benefits-recipient data was not known to be affected.
Nissan suspended part of its global dealer diagnostics system after detecting unauthorized access, delaying some repairs and replacement-key programming.
Staples Canada said unauthorized access at its print website exposed contact information, order summaries and encrypted passwords.
incidents.scale: Count not disclosed; no financial data reported exposed

incidents.what: Optimizely shut down a legacy deployment server and removed an injected script from two sites after finding unauthorized access.
Eskenazi Health disclosed that patient information may have been accessed after two employee email accounts were compromised in September.
YMCA said its Youth For Causes registration portal and database were compromised, but investigators could not establish whether personal data was copied.
GoFundMe confirmed some donor contact data was accessed and said Salesforce restored its software packages while the integration remained disabled.
A USDA undersecretary confirmed a cyberthreat and said no data was lost, while press reports describe suspected access to a farm-payment system.
incidents.scale: Loans and payments disrupted; access scope unconfirmed

incidents.what: Rokkatei expanded the potential scope of its online-shop breach to customer contact details and reported one confirmed case of fraudulent card use.
